name: lift-object
title: Lift a held object
description: Raise the held object until its bottom is at least the given world height (e.g. above a bin rim or a furniture edge before carrying).
use_when: A held object must be raised to a height (clear an obstacle, show it).

not_to_be_confused_with.stand: stand moves the torso, not the held object.
not_to_be_confused_with.pick: lift raises an object already held.

height_m.description: Minimum world height of the object's bottom.

preconditions.meaning: The object is in the given gripper: fingers not shut, TCP-to-body distance unchanged since the grasp.

postconditions.meaning: Right-held object's bottom at or above the given world height (2 cm tolerance).
The object is in the given gripper: fingers not shut, TCP-to-body distance unchanged since the grasp.

failure.on_failure: stop and report the measured pre/postconditions; nothing is retried.

returns.success: true when every precondition held, the action ran and every postcondition holds
returns.error_code: on failure: INPUT_MISSING, INPUT_UNKNOWN, PRECONDITION_FAILED, NO_PATH, POLICY_FAILED, SUBSKILL_FAILED or POSTCONDITION_FAILED
returns.preconditions: each precondition as evaluated before moving, with holds = true/false
returns.postconditions: each postcondition as evaluated after the action, with holds = true/false
returns.outputs: the measured values listed under Outputs
